landing.headlineA: Turn the daily flood of AI news
landing.subtext: Fetched from 40+ RSS feeds, AI-scored and deduped, distilled into actionable ideas. Not what happened today, but what's worth doing.
landing.pipelineTitle: From noise to signal, four steps
landing.pipelineStep1Body: Pull 40+ RSS feeds in parallel, drop noise by keyword and length.
landing.pipelineStep2Body: LLM scores by OPC monetization, agent workflows, and more. Jaccard plus semantic dedup.
landing.pipelineStep3Body: Cross-source keyword clustering. Hits in 3+ sources become strong signals.
landing.pipelineStep4Body: Combined with community discussion heat, into buildable projects with difficulty, MVP days, and monetization.
landing.insightTitle: Not just news. Things you can build.
landing.insightBody: Every Insight comes from that day's top-scored articles and community buzz. We label target users, core features, monetization, and why now, then hand it to the community to vote on priority.
landing.featuredBody: Articles scoring 5 and above, grouped by topic. Open for Chinese summary and AI commentary.
landing.finalCtaTitle: Three minutes a day, catch what's worth building
landing.finalCtaBody: Subscribe to the daily push, or jump straight into Insight to see what the community is voting on.

about.title: About
about.motivation1: AI news drops everywhere every day — scrolling manually is exhausting and easy to miss. AI Daily Pulse fetches from 40+ RSS sources, pre-filters, scores with AI, deduplicates, and produces a daily digest.
about.motivation2: Focus areas: OPC / solo-founder monetization, AI + e-commerce, tools & agent workflows, new tech & models, and funding rounds.
about.motivation3: This site is the online reading UI for those digests — browse and search history without opening Markdown files each time.
about.authorBio: Independent developer focused on AI news aggregation and solo-founder workflows.
